name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Class 9 and 10)
steps_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students (Class IX and X)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice for Scheduled Caste students studying full-time in Class 9 or 10 in a government school or a recognised school. Parents' or guardians' income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh a year. The scholarship is given for a class only once, so a student who repeats a class does not get it again for that class. Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) through your state. For 2026-27 the NSP last date is usually 31 Oct; one state notice (Meghalaya) shows 30 Oct 2026 for its students, so no date is set here. Confirm the date on NSP.
benefits: A monthly scholarship for 10 months a year, with higher rates for hostellers than for day scholars, plus an allowance for students with disabilities. Sources show different rates (older guideline ₹225 / ₹525 a month, a 2026-27 summary ₹3,500 / ₹7,000 a year), so confirm the current amount on NSP.
source_organization: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (paid through State/UT governments)
amount: Day scholar / hosteller rates (confirm on NSP)
required_documents: Income certificate of parents/guardian (not above ₹2.5 lakh)

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Class 9 and 10)
steps_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students (Class IX and X)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for Scheduled Tribe students in Class 9 or 10. Parents' or guardians' income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh a year. A student who repeats a class is not eligible for that class again. Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal. 2026-27 schedule in a state tribal-welfare circular: apply 1 Jul to 31 Oct 2026, verification by institutes by 5 Nov and by the state by 15 Dec 2026. Fresh students need an income certificate for 2025-26.
benefits: Scholarship paid by DBT; the rate depends on day scholar or hosteller. Confirm the current amount on NSP.
source_organization: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (paid through State/UT governments)
amount: Day scholar / hosteller rates (confirm on NSP)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (DEPwD)
steps_name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Central scheme of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities for students with at least 40% benchmark disability (valid UDID card) studying after Class 10, from Class 11 to PhD, including ITI, polytechnic and diploma. Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year, at most two children per family (exceptions for twins), and you must not get another scholarship or stipend. You must have passed the previous year's exam. Apply on the National Scholarship Portal. NOTE: the last date is reported as 31 Aug 2026 in a Maharashtra circular and as 31 Oct 2026 on another site, so no date is set here. Check NSP for the current date.
benefits: Scholarship and allowances paid by DBT; the amount depends on the course group and day scholar / hosteller. Confirm the current amounts on NSP.
source_organization: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
required_documents: Disability certificate / UDID card (40% or more)
Admission fee receipt and college bonafide
